name: Fix race condition in async cache warmer
description: Fix un-awaited promise chain in warmCache in src/cache-warmer.ts that causes test flakes.

inputs.task_prompt: warmCache() in src/cache-warmer.ts has a race condition where it triggers background fetches without awaiting Promise.all, causing callers to see an empty or partially populated cache. Fix warmCache so it returns a Promise that only resolves once all keys are loaded. All tests in test/cache-warmer.test.ts must pass consistently.

acceptance_criteria: warmCache returns a Promise that awaits all item warming
isWarm() returns true immediately after warmCache() resolves
Tests pass consistently across 5 consecutive runs
